description: Frontend for Step 3 question bank + rubric. Add questionApi.js and rubricApi.js wrapping apiRequest, point Questions.jsx and Rubrics.jsx at the real /questions and /rubrics endpoints (they currently call the mock /api/lecturer/* via bare fetch), add the new question fields + status/Bloom/source filters + Excel import with a per-row error table + approve/reject/archive lifecycle actions (AI generation is a disabled Step-4 placeholder only), and add rubric performance-levels + lock + clone controls. Depends on FEAT-001's endpoints being in place.
steps: Add frontend/src/services/questionApi.js wrapping apiRequest from ./authApi: listQuestions(filters) -> `/questions` with query string for status/bloom/source; getQuestion(id); createQuestion(body); updateQuestion(id,patch); deleteQuestion(id); approveQuestion(id); rejectQuestion(id,reason); archiveQuestion(id); importQuestions(file) sending raw xlsx bytes with the XLSX content-type exactly like adminApi.importStudents (the backend answers 422 {ok:false,errors} which arrives as thrown error.details); downloadTemplate() hitting GET /questions/template.

Add frontend/src/services/rubricApi.js wrapping apiRequest: listRubrics(); getRubric(id); createRubric(body with criteria[].performanceLevels[]); updateRubric(id,patch); deleteRubric(id); cloneRubric(id) -> POST /rubrics/:id/clone.

Rewrite frontend/src/pages/lecturer/Questions.jsx to use questionApi instead of bare fetch('/api/lecturer/questions'): load via listQuestions(filters); add create/edit form fields for Bloom level (REMEMBER/UNDERSTAND/APPLY/ANALYZE), language, reference answer, key points (textarea, |-joined), and purpose; status options are the new lifecycle (DRAFT/PENDING_REVIEW/APPROVED/REJECTED/ARCHIVED); add status/Bloom/source filter controls that re-query; add an Excel import action that calls importQuestions and renders the returned per-row error table ({row, errors[]}) on 422; add approve / reject(with reason prompt) / archive action buttons per row reflecting the lifecycle; add a DISABLED 'Generate with AI' placeholder button with no generation logic. Keep user-facing strings in the existing English UI style and reuse the shared UI/Modal components.

Update frontend/src/pages/lecturer/Rubrics.jsx to use rubricApi: render and edit performance levels per criterion (label, min_score, max_score, description, order_no); show a lock indicator and disable editing when is_locked; add a Clone control calling cloneRubric and surfacing the new version.
acceptance_criteria: From frontend/, `npm run lint` reports no errors.
From frontend/, `npm run build` completes successfully.
Questions.jsx and Rubrics.jsx import from questionApi.js / rubricApi.js and no longer call /api/lecturer/questions or /api/lecturer/rubrics.

Questions.jsx form includes Bloom, language, reference answer, key points, and purpose fields; status/Bloom/source filters; an Excel import action that renders the per-row error table; and approve/reject/archive actions. The 'Generate with AI' control is present but disabled.
Rubrics.jsx exposes performance levels per criterion plus lock (edit disabled when locked) and clone controls.
verification: cd d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step3-questionbank\frontend ; npm run build  (expect: build succeeds)
findings:
VERIFICATION (from worktree frontend/): `npm run lint` => exit 0, warnings only, NO errors (clean per acceptance). The two new warnings on Questions.jsx:64 and Rubrics.jsx:43 are react(set-state-in-effect) from the load()-in-useEffect pattern that already exists verbatim in admin/Users.jsx and admin/Subjects.jsx; left as-is to match the codebase convention. `npm run build` => exit 0, 'built in ~2.9s', 2324 modules transformed.

NEW FILES:
- frontend/src/services/questionApi.js wraps apiRequest(authApi): listQuestions(filters) builds a query string from {status,bloom,source} dropping empty values; getQuestion/createQuestion/updateQuestion/deleteQuestion; approveQuestion(id); rejectQuestion(id,reason) (POST body {reason}); archiveQuestion(id); importQuestions(file) sends raw xlsx bytes with the spreadsheet Content-Type exactly like adminApi.importStudents (422 arrives as thrown error.details); downloadTemplate() does its OWN fetch (NOT apiRequest, which only decodes JSON) to GET /questions/template, reads the blob, and triggers a browser download as question-import-template.xlsx.
- frontend/src/services/rubricApi.js wraps apiRequest: listRubrics/getRubric/createRubric/updateRubric/deleteRubric and cloneRubric(id) -> POST /rubrics/:id/clone.

Questions.jsx: now imports questionApi (no more fetch('/api/lecturer/questions')). Loads via listQuestions(filters) in a useCallback effect keyed on filters, so changing a filter re-queries. Create/edit modal has fields for content, Bloom (REMEMBER/UNDERSTAND/APPLY/ANALYZE), language, reference answer, key points (textarea, '|'-joined -> array on save, array -> '|'-joined on load), purpose, and status (DRAFT/PENDING_REVIEW/APPROVED/REJECTED/ARCHIVED). Status/Bloom/Source filter selects above the table ('All ...' = empty = unset). Per-row lifecycle buttons: Approve (handles RUBRIC_REQUIRED + INVALID_TRANSITION messages), Reject (window.prompt for reason, REASON_REQUIRED guard client-side + INVALID_TRANSITION), Archive, plus Edit/Delete. Excel import via hidden file input + 'Import Excel' button; on 422 with details.errors it renders the per-row {row, errors[]} table (mirrors admin/Users.jsx). 'Template' button calls downloadTemplate(). 'Generate with AI' is a DISABLED placeholder button (Sparkles icon, title 'Available in a future release') with NO generation logic. DUPLICATE_QUESTION on save shows 'This question already exists.' Create/update send a bare body; create response envelope {question,warnings} is ignored (list reload drives the table). Question fields read from the bare toApiQuestion shape (bloomLevel, source, rubricId, keyPoints[]).

Rubrics.jsx: now imports rubricApi (no more fetch('/api/lecturer/rubrics')). Table shows version + a lock/editable State badge. Edit modal renders nested criteria[] each with name/weightPercent/description and a performanceLevels[] editor (label, minScore, maxScore, orderNo, description) with add/remove criterion + add/remove level controls. When isLocked: Edit button disabled, all inputs + add/remove + Save disabled, and a lock banner tells the user to clone. Clone button calls cloneRubric and surfaces the new version via a notice. RUBRIC_LOCKED on save shows the clone-to-edit message. Payloads coerce numeric fields with Number().

UI STYLE: kept the pre-existing Questions.jsx/Rubrics.jsx convention (plain btn/form-* classes + shared components/Modal.jsx + inline-styled tables + lucide-react icons), NOT the ui/* component set admin pages use, so the two pages stay internally consistent. All user-facing strings are English. No backend or FEAT-001 files were touched. 'purpose' is sent/read as a top-level field (backend maps it to rationale.purpose).

NOTE for later steps: these pages do not yet provide a UI to pick topicId/rubricId when creating a question, so createQuestion posts without them and the backend defaults status to DRAFT unless an explicit status is chosen; approve then fails with RUBRIC_REQUIRED until a rubric is attached. If Step 4 needs lecturers to attach a topic/rubric at create time, add those selectors (needs topic + rubric list endpoints wired into the page).
